integrity: The printed generator is reconstructed over GF(9). The published ordinary weight enumerator is reproduced exactly before every message subspace is enumerated once in reduced-row-echelon form. All four possible primitive choices for the displayed omega notation give the same support census.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the displayed Example 6.1 code only; no family-wide formula or equivalence classification is claimed. The generalized Hamming hierarchy itself follows from the NMDS property and is not claimed as new.
title: Complete higher-support spectrum of the \([11,5,6]_9\) EGRL example
